binary_system_red_giant.conclusion: Red Giant conversion is implemented by adding the COLD base damage to FIRE (and, when Binary is not active, subtracting the COLD original => cold->fire conversion). This is not a generic +100% more stat and therefore is unlikely to be inherited by Ignite damage (Ignite base is the ailment asset 40 fire, not the ability base damage).
